historical_reviews.deepseek: Recognizes package and state-change dependency but replaces exact source semantics with an unspecified generic operation.

historical_reviews.related_cases: AGT VBIOS and FRU flashes use different targets and cannot prove RM-controller firmware coverage.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Separates review completion from execution approval and DUT verdict; rejects guessed image, mode or retry.

original_test_intent: Update the selected GPU remote-management controller with the approved RM firmware image through the source's exact AGT target/mode and verify the intended version plus post-update health.
original_method: Establish stable GPU/RM identity and current version, validate signed compatible image and exact vendor semantics for tuple `4,100,0,1`, back up recoverable state, obtain explicit approval, flash once under stable power/thermal conditions, perform only approved activation, then compare RM version and management/GPU/PCIe/log health.
manual_activity: GPU/RM firmware owner supplies and approves the exact signed image, target, command semantics, outage and recovery plan and owns the final verdict.
required_inputs: Signed AGT binary/hash and vendor mode guide
Signed RM image/hash/compatibility manifest and expected version
Stable GPU/RM/I2C target map and current-version backup
Maintenance window, explicit destructive-action approval and stable power/thermal state
Vendor recovery/rollback path and protected evidence location
safety_requirements: Refuse unsigned, incompatible or ambiguous image/target/mode
Confirm current and expected versions plus recoverable backup
Flash one approved target once under stable power and telemetry
Never retry automatically or substitute another image; invoke approved recovery on mismatch
agent_execution_scope: After explicit approval run only the vendor-confirmed exact update once
Capture activation and post-update version/health evidence
Stop and escalate without assigning DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve exact image, target, semantics, outage and recovery
Disposition update/version/health anomalies and set PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The generic update loses the source's exact AGT target/mode and cannot establish image or target identity.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Only after all gates and approval, run the vendor-confirmed equivalent of `./agt -i2cflm:4,100,0,1,<validated-image>` once against the confirmed RM target; preserve exact argv and logs.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Tuple `4,100,0,1`, five-minute attended and ten-minute machine expectations remain; any activation time must be explicitly governed.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use an immutable tool/image manifest, two-person target confirmation, pre-version/backup, stable telemetry, one-shot update and expected-versus-observed version/health table.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes 'update successfully' attributable, recoverable and health-qualified without changing firmware coverage.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Generic GPU firmware, VBIOS or FRU evidence cannot substitute for RM firmware on this exact target.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A successful process exit is insufficient if activation selects another bank or management/PCIe health regresses.

project_override_considerations: Platform firmware owner controls compatible RM image, activation/bank policy, maintenance timing, target mapping and recovery tooling.
expected_evidence: Signed AGT and RM-image manifests plus compatibility approval
Stable target identity, current/expected version and backup/recovery proof
Explicit approval, power/thermal baseline and exact argv
Post RM version/bank plus GPU/driver/PCIe/management health and OS/BMC log delta

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master consistently specifies an RM firmware update; DeepSeek is only incomplete and generic.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Signed tool/image, approval and recovery are project inputs; missing provisioning does not make the static review blocked.

review_improvement: Preserves the exact RM-flash tuple while adding immutable identity, approval, one-shot, recovery and post-health controls.
independent_technical_reasoning: RM firmware is distinct from GPU VBIOS and can affect controller availability while leaving a flash utility exit code at zero. Therefore acceptance must bind signed image and physical/logical target to an expected active version and prove management plus GPU/PCIe health. Repeating a partially failed flash without vendor recovery guidance can increase corruption, so automatic retry is prohibited.
